name: foreman
description: Run a coding project with one lead agent and a crew of worker agents. The lead plans, writes a brief for each task, sends workers out, tracks pull requests and keeps a compact handover. Each worker takes one brief, works in its own git worktree and stops.

interface.longDescription: Foreman keeps the lead's context small: one task per worker, one worker per pull request, follow-up fixes to fresh workers, and one handover per repository, or per topic, that new sessions start from. Includes the foreman, foreman-create and foreman-resume lead skills and five worker agents: builder, investigator, clerk, scout and responder.
